source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

parts.target: A **GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY** unit of yours.
parts.effect: Whenever an enemy unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** up to 6" from the unit, or is placed on the battlefield up to 6" from it, roll a D6, adding 2 if the unit is wholly inside your [Hallowed Ground](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.warpbane-task-force.hallowed-ground). If the result is 4+, the enemy unit takes D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**. This lasts for the rest of the phase.

data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as it begins.

**Target:** A **GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY** unit of yours.

**Effect:** Whenever an enemy unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** up to 6" from the unit, or is placed on the battlefield up to 6" from it, roll a D6, adding 2 if the unit is wholly inside your [Hallowed Ground](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.warpbane-task-force.hallowed-ground). If the result is 4+, the enemy unit takes D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**. This lasts for the rest of the phase.
